title: Does Supergirl Have Any Post-Credits Scenes at the End? Number Revealed - NewsBreak
text:
By Shazmeen Navrange ,
1 hours ago Photo Credit: Warner Bros. Pictures Viewers are curious whether there’s a post-, mid-, or end-credits scene in Supergirl . Directed by Craig Gillespie, the superhero movie follows Kara Zor-El and her dog, Krypto. Together, they celebrate her 23rd birthday, traveling across the galaxy. Things take an unexpected turn when she experiences a tragedy, which leads her to embark on a quest for vengeance. As the movie will be premiered on June 26, fans are wondering whether they should stay back for additional scenes.
Are there any Supergirl post-credits scenes at the end? There are no post-, mid-, or end-credit scenes in Supergirl. The audience is free to leave the theaters once the credits begin to roll.
Filmmakers typically add a bonus scene to either tease a sequel or to resolve existing plot queries. Some franchises like Marvel also leverage it to hint at a character’s return, potentially building hype and anticipation for future installments. However, in Supergirl’s case, the story appears to be self-contained with no loose ends. Moreover, there has been no announcement of a potential sequel in the works. Viewers will still get to witness Milly Alcock’s character in David Corenswet-led Man of Tomorrow, set to release on July 9, 2027.
In a conversation with Extra TV, James Gunn, co-CEO of DC Studios, discussed how Supergirl differs from her cousin, Superman. This difference is expected to lead to a conflict between them. Gunn stated that this clash will play a significant role in the upcoming 2027 movie.
He clarified that Supergirl’s role will not be restricted to a cameo this time but will be significant. “Milly’s got a big role in that one [Man of Tomorrow]. I feel sorry for her because she’s flying around the world, coming to set, shooting with me, coming back, having to do more press, flying back. So, it’s hard. It’s hard. But she’s a trooper,” he explained.
